requirement: test these five classes explicitly and report each, including zeros
how_the_test_is_scoped: classes 1-4 live BELOW the marks that hide them, so they are decomposed at UNICODE_NORMALIZED -- but only for a pair whose scripts AND accent notations already agree. For any other pair the difference there is dominated by script or notation, which is not a structural class, so the row records separable=false with the reason instead of inventing one. Class 5 is whatever survives to the pair's own ceiling, so an exact pair touches no class 5 BY CONSTRUCTION.
